blocks.head: alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device or away from it. A remote press targets deviceB
alt The user is near the device

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < deviceB | ('online' : false , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ UserX 'buttonPress' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('online' : true , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

ceq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (Key) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ..) , ...) > if Key == Key .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceB) 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : Near , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : Near , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .
